newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks fall on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks fall on profit-taking.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed lower for the fourth straight day as local investors booked profit from selected stocks, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.31 points down at 599.99. Lanka Walltile fell three rupees to 25.50, Central Industries five to 73.75.
"The index rose from about 560 level mainly on retail activity among cheap shares. There is a lot more profit to be taken among these same stocks," said Alistair Corera of brokerge Forbes and Walker.
